description: This file contains utility functions for creating lazy-loaded runtime surfaces, modules, named exports, and methods, facilitating deferred and cached dynamic imports within a TypeScript project.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeSurface<TModule, TSurface>( createLazyRuntimeSurface
methods.description: Creates a lazily-loaded surface of a module, caching the Promise of the selected surface for repeated use.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeModule<TModule>( createLazyRuntimeModule
methods.description: Creates a lazily-loaded module, caching the entire module Promise.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeNamedExport<TModule, const TKey extends keyof TModule>( createLazyRuntimeNamedExport
methods.description: Creates a lazy loader for a specific named export of a module.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeMethod<TSurface, TArgs extends unknown[], TResult>( createLazyRuntimeMethod
methods.description: Creates a lazily-loaded method from a surface, with deferred invocation and caching.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeMethodBinder<TSurface>(load: () => Promise<TSurface>) { createLazyRuntimeMethodBinder
methods.description: Returns a function to create lazily-loaded methods bound to a specific surface load function.
